content.text:
All tests and type-checks pass.

**What I changed:** `identifyAuthor()` in `src/lib/analytics.ts` now calls `identify.add("seen_count", 1)` in addition to the existing `set()` calls for name/site count. Amplitude's `Identify.add` is a server-side increment on the user's profile — every call to `identifyAuthor` (i.e., every sign-in, once that flow lands) bumps a persistent total rather than replacing a per-call value, which is what "keeps climbing on every call" needs. `.set()` was the wrong tool here since it overwrites.

I also updated the mock in `analytics.test.ts` to include `add`, and added a test asserting `add("seen_count", 1)` is called on identify.
